name: io.github.iwiels/codebase-synapse
title: codebase-synapse
description: MCP server that indexes your codebase into a local knowledge graph using Tree-sitter. 40+ tools for semantic search, call graph traversal, impact analysis, git archaeology, and FMEA risk scoring. Includes codebase-guard — a PreToolUse hook that blocks AI agent writes to high-impact files until impact_analysis runs.
